information_bound: For clipped probabilities >=epsilon, paired log-score difference in[-b,b], b=-log(epsilon). L=mean-b*sqrt(2log(1/alpha)/n). Same bound for probe-minus-hold score.
H2_bound: LowerCP(n_plus,n,alpha/2)-UpperCP(n_minus,n,alpha/2); no independence of discordant counts assumed. Conservative power is lower than normal halfwidth suggests.
